comment: Web package size budgets in bytes, upper limits, one set per profile (docs/web-build.html explains each number: measured in the web CI job of PR #174, plus about 15 percent headroom, rounded; re-measured in PR #181 with WebAudio linked: wasm +0.4 percent, initial brotli +0.8 percent, so none was changed). PR #184 links PhysX for WebAssembly and RAISED every limit on purpose: in the web CI job the size profile wasm grew from 3,946,067 to 6,687,032 bytes raw and from 765,466 to 1,537,129 brotli, the speed profile wasm from 9,351,938 to 12,310,792 raw and from 991,892 to 1,771,548 brotli, and the dev profile wasm from 226,038,712 to 232,622,594 raw; each new limit is the new measurement plus about 15 percent, rounded up. Read by scripts/web-budget-check.mjs in the web CI job. Keys: <kind>.<size>, kind = wasm|js|data|initial (initial = every file of the package), size = raw|gzip|brotli.
